title: Noisy sources
description: Which log sources keep raising anomalies, and how much of that the closed triage items call noise. Times are UTC.

facts.noCollection: No evaluation has been recorded yet.
facts.summary: {total, plural, one {# source} other {# sources}} raised at least one anomaly in the last {days} days. Ordered by {order}.

partial.title: Partial coverage.
partial.text: Nothing is known about the rest, so these numbers are lower bounds, not totals.

table.label: Noisy sources
table.caption: Log sources ranked by anomalies raised, with alerts, the share closed as noise and the worst deviation
table.notMonitoredHint: This source is not monitored, so no counts are collected.
table.notJudgedHint: A low count here is not evidence of calm.

footnote: Noise and worst deviation always cover the last 28 days of stored data, whichever window is selected. Incidents and alerts follow the selected window.

quiet.summary: No incidents on {count, plural, one {# source} other {# sources}}
quiet.judged: {count, plural, one {# source is} other {# sources are}} judged and raised nothing in {days} days.
quiet.notJudged: {count, plural, one {# source is} other {# sources are}} not judged: no reliable baseline for this weekday and hour. A quiet count there is not evidence of calm.
quiet.none: Every monitored source raised at least one anomaly in the last {days} days.

empty.title: No source raised an anomaly
empty.fallback: No source raised an anomaly in the last {days} days of stored data.
empty.withCollection: The last evaluation was <time></time>, so the collection is running and the window is quiet.
empty.noCollection: No evaluation has been recorded, so this may be a missing collection and not a quiet window.

pastEnd.title: This page is past the end of the list
pastEnd.text: {total, plural, one {# source} other {# sources}} raised anomalies; the list starts at row {offset}.

errors.title: The noisy-sources list could not be loaded
errors.failed: The counts are unknown, not zero. Reload the page; if it fails again, check that the API is reachable and ask an administrator.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to view noisy sources. Ask an administrator for the read:anomalies grant.
errors.expired: Your session has expired. Sign in again to see the list.
